directives.intuition: Bond stress may force CB/Treasury action or trigger sharper risk-off within 48-72h; watch credit spreads and equity acceleration—USD could weaken if flight-to-quality dominates yield support
directives.summary: Geopolitical spike aging (Hormuz attack 6h, no follow-up); bond rout dominant (US 30Y 19Y high); BoJ signals Sept hike (JPY strong); GBP weak into CPI; caution mode
